Local fixture sites for the website import (apps/api/test/site-import.test.ts and the e2e stack). They imitate the markup of common
builders (Squarespace, Wix, Shopify), a hand-made page and a page with rich JSON-LD. Every business, address and number is made up
(555 numbers). `logo.png` files are generated by test/site-fixtures.ts, not stored here. Never point a test at the real internet.
